_comment: Captured OpenCode request failures, in the shapes OpenCode recorded on 2026-10-24. The account names, workspace identifiers and request identifiers were removed or replaced with placeholders; the types, statuses, messages, bodies and retry waits are as recorded. These rows are evidence of what a refusal looks like, not a history of an account.

records.note: NVIDIA free route, refused with a bare HTTP 429 and no retry wait.

error.message: Provider request failed with HTTP 429: {"status":429,"title":"Too Many Requests"}

records.note: The OpenCode Free instance, refused when the free allowance was spent.

error.message: Free usage limit reached. Connect a provider or subscribe to OpenCode Go to keep going, or switch models.

response.body: {"type":"error","error":{"type":"FreeUsageLimitError","message":"Free usage limit reached. Subscribe to OpenCode Go to keep going: https://opencode.ai/go"}}

records.note: OpenCode Go, refused against the monthly allowance with the wait the provider asked for.
A refusal with no HTTP status: the record does not say the route was refused against a limit.
